* '''PC-E1''' ([[BT-1 & •Triple Zero (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 24 release sheet<ref name="sheet24-20250202">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-24.pdf Virtual Set 24 release sheet] (PDF, 3 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, December 2024”; file created 2 February 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 24]] (30 December 2024); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 1, file created 2 February 2025: “<nowiki>*</nowiki> Astromech &amp; Protocol Droid. If with Aphra, may add one destiny to attrition. If opponent's character of ability &lt; 4 here is about to leave table, may use 1 Force; opponent loses 1 Force.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[BT-1 & •Triple Zero]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[BT-1 & •Triple Zero]] (published 26 December 2024) as a printable slip under the label “•BT-1 & •Triple Zero”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
